_version.author: Ash Higgins
source_refs: Calibrated against 3,123 released notification narratives, 2022 to 2026

_why_this_file_exists: The Assessment Strategy specifies expert-comparison scoring with a deterministic element-detection layer. This is that layer, implementable. Every pattern has been run against the real corpus and its match rate recorded, so an implementation can be verified rather than assumed correct.

_implementation_notes.engine: Python re, case-insensitive where flagged. No third-party dependency.
_implementation_notes.input: The operator's report text as a single string.
_implementation_notes.output: One boolean per check, plus the conditional results. Never a score. Scoring is the rubric's job.
_implementation_notes.verification: Run every pattern over the corpus and compare against expected_match_rate. A deviation beyond tolerance means the pattern was transcribed wrongly.
_implementation_notes.known_limitation: Pattern detection undercounts unconventional phrasing. Every rate is a floor. This is stated to the operator in the debrief: absence of a detected element prompts a check rather than asserting a failure.

_calibration_warning: Patterns are easy to get subtly wrong in ways that silently invert the result. An earlier version of the delta-v pattern placed a negative lookahead after a zero-width match, so it fired on every report and produced a completely false statistic that reached operator-facing content. **Test every pattern against the corpus before trusting it.**

checks.name: time_header
checks.detects: Julian day and Zulu time header
checks.on_absent: No time header. Every report opens with Julian day and time.

checks.name: register_possible
checks.detects: Possible-register language

checks.name: register_verified
checks.detects: Verified-register language

checks.name: confidence_level
checks.detects: An explicit confidence level
checks.on_absent: No confidence level stated. Present in under 8 per cent of real reports, and the largest single gap in the corpus.

checks.name: hedge
checks.detects: Hedging language. Not a failure in itself; feeds CND-01

checks.name: pattern_of_life
checks.detects: An explicit pattern of life comparison
checks.on_absent: No pattern of life assessment. Present in about a third of real reports and the weaker half of the assessment pair.

checks.name: consequence
checks.detects: Consequence or affected-object content, including an explicit no-impact statement
checks.on_absent: No consequence stated. An explicit statement that nobody is affected satisfies this check.

checks.name: limitation
checks.detects: A stated limitation or ongoing-analysis marker
checks.caveat: Inflated by the standing analysis-is-ongoing phrase. A stricter variant excluding it detects substantive limitations only and is preferred for scoring; see CHK-08b.

checks.name: limitation_substantive
checks.detects: A substantive collection or data limitation, excluding standing boilerplate
checks.note: **Use this one for scoring.** CHK-08 is retained for comparability with earlier figures.

checks.name: specifics_block
checks.detects: The standard specifics block
checks.on_absent: No specifics block. Required on manoeuvre reports, in fixed order, with a not-applicable value where a field does not apply.

checks.name: delta_v_quoted
checks.detects: A delta-v figure. Feeds CND-02

checks.name: delta_v_units
checks.detects: A delta-v figure carrying units
checks.note: **This pattern replaced a broken one.** The original placed a negative lookahead after a zero-width match and fired on every report, producing a false 42 per cent deficit that reached a drill. The true deficit is 0.4 per cent.

checks.name: drift_quoted
checks.detects: A drift rate figure. Feeds CND-03

checks.name: drift_direction
checks.detects: A drift rate carrying an east or west direction
checks.note: **This is the real qualifier gap.** Only 29.4 per cent of quoted drift rates carry a direction. A rate without direction tells the reader the object is moving and not which way.

checks.name: state_appended
checks.detects: An appended element set. Feeds CND-04 and CND-05

checks.name: state_provider
checks.detects: A named provider for an appended state
checks.note: Provider names are configuration. Implementations should read the provider list from the local thresholds file rather than hardcoding it.

checks.name: state_time_current
checks.detects: The time an appended state was current

checks.name: template_residue
checks.detects: Unfilled template placeholders
checks.on_present: Template placeholder text survived into the report. One read end to end before release catches this.

checks.name: products_referenced
checks.detects: A products reference

checks.name: pai_paragraph
checks.detects: A hedged publicly-available-information paragraph
checks.note: Low corpus rate reflects a convention adopted recently rather than a gap. Do not present a low score here as a failure without checking the reporting period.

checks.name: alpha5_dual
checks.detects: Both identifier forms provided together for a catalogue number above the five-digit range
checks.note: Zero occurrences in the corpus because the convention post-dates it. Scored only where the scenario seeds such an object.

conditional_checks.name: hedge_sized
conditional_checks.fails_when: The report hedges and states no confidence level
conditional_checks.operator_message: You hedged without sizing the doubt. Add a confidence level, or replace the hedge with what is known and what is not. Fewer than one in ten real reports that hedge also state a confidence.

conditional_checks.name: delta_v_qualified
conditional_checks.fails_when: A delta-v is quoted without units
conditional_checks.note: Rarely fails in practice. Retained because when it does fail the consequence is severe.

conditional_checks.name: drift_qualified
conditional_checks.fails_when: A drift rate is quoted without an east or west direction
conditional_checks.operator_message: Drift rate quoted without a direction. A rate without direction tells the reader the object is moving and not which way, and this is the most commonly omitted qualifier in real reporting.

conditional_checks.name: state_provenance_provider
conditional_checks.fails_when: A state is appended without a named provider
conditional_checks.operator_message: Appended state without a provider. It cannot be reconciled against another source.

conditional_checks.name: state_provenance_time
conditional_checks.fails_when: A state is appended without the time it was current
conditional_checks.operator_message: Appended state without the time it was current. Staleness cannot be judged, so the state cannot safely be used.

conditional_checks.name: register_consistent
conditional_checks.custom: Where the opening sentence is in the possible register, the body must not assert the event as established. Detect by comparing register markers in the first sentence against the remainder.
conditional_checks.fails_when: A possible-register opening is followed by a body that asserts the event as fact
conditional_checks.operator_message: Register drifted. You opened in the possible register and the body reads as established. Sustain the register through the report.

anatomy_detection.note: The eight event anatomy questions, detected for the debrief. Reported as answered, implied or absent rather than pass or fail, because implicit answers are common and are a coaching point rather than an error.

questions.name: enablement
questions.note: Weakest question in both the package and the corpus. Weighted most heavily in the debrief.

verification_procedure.note: Run this before trusting an implementation.
steps: Load a corpus of released report narratives.
Run every check and record the match rate.
Any check outside tolerance has been transcribed wrongly. Do not adjust the expected rate to fit; fix the pattern.
Run the conditional checks and compare against measured_satisfaction.
Where no corpus is available, the expected rates still serve as a sanity check against synthetic text: a check matching 100 per cent or 0 per cent of everything is almost certainly broken.
verification_procedure.failure_mode_to_watch: A pattern that matches everything looks like a working detector until someone computes a percentage from it. Assert both a floor and a ceiling.
